issue.usage:
usage: kander issue <command> [options]
       kander issue repo [--repo HOST/OWNER/REPO] [--json]
       kander issue list [--repo HOST/OWNER/REPO] [--state open|closed|all] [--label NAME] [--search TEXT] [--limit N] [--json]
       kander issue show NUMBER [--repo HOST/OWNER/REPO] [--comments] [--json]
       kander issue import NUMBER [--repo HOST/OWNER/REPO] [--comments] [--type feature|bug|chore|research] [--large] [--language LANG] [--json]
       kander issue triage NUMBER [--card TASK_ID] [--repo HOST/OWNER/REPO] [--agent NAME] [--launcher NAME]
issue.error_no_remote: no GitHub remote was found in this repository
issue.error_insecure_remote: remote {{.V0}} embeds credentials; remove them before using the GitHub integration
issue.error_unsupported_host: a host with an explicit port is not supported: {{.V0}}
issue.error_unauthenticated: GitHub CLI is not authenticated for {{.V0}}
issue.error_not_found: repository not found or not accessible: {{.V0}}
issue.error_timeout: the GitHub CLI command timed out
issue.error_output_limit: the GitHub CLI command produced too much output
issue.remediation_repo_flag: pass --repo HOST/OWNER/REPO to select a repository explicitly
issue.remediation_set_default: or pick a default remote with `gh repo set-default HOST/OWNER/REPO`
tui.issues_hint: Enter detail  / search  Tab state  l label  i import/jump  I with comments  s hand off  r refresh  o browser  Esc close
tui.issues_detail_hint: Enter opens the selected issue with its comments
issue.error_not_an_issue: {{.V0}} is a pull request, not an issue
issue.remediation_issue_number: Use the issue number shown in the list.
issue.list_usage: usage: kander issue list [--repo HOST/OWNER/REPO] [--state open|closed|all] [--label NAME] [--search TEXT] [--limit N] [--json]
issue.show_usage: usage: kander issue show NUMBER [--repo HOST/OWNER/REPO] [--comments] [--json]
issue.import_usage: usage: kander issue import NUMBER [--repo HOST/OWNER/REPO] [--comments] [--type feature|bug|chore|research] [--large] [--language LANG] [--json]
issue.error_import_conflict: an existing card has an unreadable import snapshot: {{.V0}}
issue.remediation_reduce_scope: retry with a smaller scope: reduce --limit, drop --comments, or pick a smaller issue
issue.remediation_check_board: run `kander check` and repair that card, then retry
issue.triage_usage: usage: kander issue triage NUMBER [--card TASK_ID] [--repo HOST/OWNER/REPO] [--agent NAME] [--launcher NAME]
tui.import_issue: Import as card / jump to card
tui.issues_takeover_body: Start a takeover agent session for {{.V0}}. The agent reads the refreshed evidence, investigates the issue and confirms the plan with you; it imports the card only after you agree. No card is created or moved here.
tui.issues_takeover_started: Takeover session started: {{.V0}} ({{.V1}}) at {{.V2}}. The agent investigates the issue and asks before importing a card.
tui.issues_takeover_failed: The takeover session could not be started: {{.V0}}
tui.issues_takeover_preview_failed: The takeover settings could not be resolved: {{.V0}}
tui.issues_takeover_unavailable: This build cannot start takeover sessions; use the CLI.
tui.issues_contract_body: Card {{.V0}} already carries this issue and is in {{.V1}}. Completing its contract starts the same takeover session for that card; jumping focuses it on the board.
tui.issues_bound_state: Task {{.V0}} is in {{.V1}}; focused it on the board. Takeover is only offered for backlog cards.
